newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 16.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for June 16.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Monday amid generally balmy weather, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Warm weather and clear skies with winds 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) and waves three to six feet high. Some light rains along lower region of coast. -- Gulf of Mexico:
Hot and clear skies with winds 10 to 15 knots and waves three to five feet high.
Cloudy with medium to strong rains along the coasts of Honduras and Nicaragua. Mostly sunny skies with winds 10 to 15 knots and waves three to five feet high.
